notes_correction.why_removing_the_unpublished_sentence_pu: Deleting a sentence that said 'unpublished' does not publish a record. The lifecycle state is carried by Zenodo itself and by this repository's markers -- record_submitted = false, record_state = unsubmitted, doi_published = false, doi_publicly_activated = false, public_release = false -- and never by prose in a Notes field. Reading the shorter Notes as a status change is a misreading, and the generator refuses to build a record that makes it.
notes_correction.why_the_authoritative_text_is_publicatio: The authoritative Notes asserts only the IDENTITY OF THE DEPOSITED BYTES -- the exact SHA-256 and size of the RC3 artifact -- plus the supersession chain, none of which changes when a record's lifecycle changes. It is therefore equally true of a draft and of a published record, and needs no further edit.
notes_correction.why_the_historical_text_was_not_publicat: The historical Notes asserted the record's LIFECYCLE STATUS -- that it is an unpublished Zenodo draft whose DOI has been reserved but not published or activated, and that no public release has occurred. Every one of those clauses is true today and each would become FALSE the instant the record were ever published, so the text would have had to be edited again at publication time.

why_a_completed_review_is_not_a_publicat: A human reading a private draft and confirming that its file, title, creators, description, keywords, version, license, Citation and reserved DOIs are correct changes nothing about the record's lifecycle. Zenodo's second lifecycle step -- publish/submit, which registers the DOI, makes the record public and makes the file downloadable -- was NOT performed and is NOT authorized. record_submitted is false, record_state is `unsubmitted`, doi_published is false, doi_publicly_activated is false and public_release is false.
why_a_notes_correction_is_not_a_publicat: The Notes field is free-text metadata on the deposition. Editing it in the Zenodo UI and saving the result as a Draft is a metadata-only change to an unpublished record: no file was uploaded, replaced or removed, no archive byte moved, the record was not submitted and no DOI was activated. A saved Draft is still a Draft.
why_open_access_right_is_not_public_avai: `access_right: open` is DRAFT metadata: it states the access condition the record would carry IF it were ever published. It is not a statement that the record is published, public, discoverable or citable, and it is not evidence of current public availability. While `submitted = false` and `state = unsubmitted`, the deposition is a PRIVATE draft visible only to its owner, and both reserved DOIs are placeholder identifiers that do not resolve.
why_the_programmer_did_not_verify_this_i: This action made ZERO Zenodo calls of any kind, authenticated or unauthenticated, and opened no browser against Zenodo. Every fact recorded here about the live Zenodo record was supplied by the human who performed the review and the edit. The repository must not claim an independent retrieval or verification that never happened, so independently_retrieved_by_programmer is false and zenodo_api_calls_made_by_this_action is 0.
